factions.name: Burrowborn
factions.communication: Vibration through rock: a hurt Burrowborn calls its kind nearby.
factions.territory: Nests and tunnels in the Shallows; they rarely chase far from home.
factions.visual: Dark wet hide, pale exposed tissue, mineral plates, faint green bioluminescence; eyes are small or absent.

factions.name: The Castoffs
traits: gang up on the lone operator
camp scavengers fight without tricks; the hideout crews telegraph every real blow
factions.communication: Shouting across the camp: hit one and the others nearby come running.
factions.hierarchy: Scavenger → Lookout / Raider (tier 1) → Gunner (tier 2) → Trooper / Vanguard (tier 3) → the Warlord (hideout boss)
factions.territory: Camps and wreck yards outside the Outpost, the old convoy roads and the first open shafts; their hideout is four floors under Frontier Road east. They never go deeper.
factions.visual: Camp scavengers: long coats, flat caps, balaclavas, patched leather and denim. Hideout crews: salvaged military kit, gas masks, and for the trusted few plate from a sealed VDI crate the Warlord brought up from the deep.

factions.name: The Rustbound
factions.identity: Industrial + decayed: VDI machines still receiving instructions (PROVISIONAL)
traits: heavier, slower and harder-hitting than the Castoffs
hunt by sensor in the dark
factions.communication: Radio chatter and warning lights; turrets and traps share the floor's power grid.
factions.hierarchy: War Drone → Miner Unit / Sentry Turret → Haze Skirmisher / Pelter → Chopper (foreman)
factions.territory: The Pump Works: a drowned VDI pump station under the Sump, four floors down.
factions.visual: Rusted steel, exposed servos, cables, warning stripes, amber status lamps.

factions.name: The Architects
factions.visual: Dark ceramic, stone, impossible symmetry, pale light.

factions.name: The Hollow
factions.visual: Pale tissue, crystal, distorted anatomy, almost no technology.

factions.name: The Wyrms
traits: solitary hunters that share one nest
territorial around the nest, predatory in the galleries
breathe fire (telegraphed: they rear back first)
lick their wounds when left alone
factions.communication: None observed: each wyrm hunts alone; they gather only around the nest.
factions.territory: The Cinder Deep: ruined galleries of an older people, swallowed by rock, under the cleft off Frontier Road east.
factions.visual: Scaled hide in ash browns and soot greys, ember glow in the throat; nests in ash, bone and petrified eggs.

factions.name: The Mutants
factions.identity: Human + animal + whatever came up the shafts (PROVISIONAL)
traits: people and animals changed by what VDI's deepest shafts let out
surface at the Saltpan; the salt flats' edges are theirs
stronger than the Castoffs, weaker than the Wyrms
detect from further and follow further than people do
telegraph every special blow: a red arc, ring or lane, a green line for acid
factions.communication: Squeals and calls within a species: a hurt brood brings the pack.
factions.hierarchy: Brood → Zombine Miner / Ripper / Acid Spitter → Tribal Bug
factions.territory: The Saltpan's edges: the north-west hoodoo hollow, the north rim and the south-west flats. They keep off the convoy road.
factions.visual: Torn work clothes over wrong anatomy, sickly skin, extra heads and mouths, bone blades, scrap and feathers; acid green.
